title: [spec-bug][R-ADR-019] appendix 7.6 cites draft-lichen-rpl-lora for epoch/num_slots RPL config option; draft has neither, implementations use TDMA beacon
description: spec/appendix-design-rationale.md:387-389: Root includes epoch and num_slots (default 8) in extended RPL config option (see draft-lichen-rpl-lora). spec/drafts/draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00.md section 4.2 DODAG Configuration (:141-148) and Appendix A (:520-540) contain neither field (zero num_slots hits in the draft). All three stacks DODAG Configuration option (type 4) has no epoch/num_slots: rust/lichen-rpl/src/message.rs:655-718, lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/include/lichen/rpl_messages.h:456-500, python/src/lichen/rpl/messages.py:96-135. epoch+num_slots actually ride the TDMA beacon header: rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs:5-15 (offset 0 epoch u32 BE, offset 4 num_slots u8), python/src/lichen/rpl/tdma_beacon.py:10-11, C beacon.c:41. Default 8 real: C tdma.c:53,89, link/Kconfig:167-168. Found during appendix-design-rationale sweep. Suggested fix: repoint the appendix cross-ref to the TDMA beacon format, or add the fields to the draft if the RPL-config-option placement is still wanted.
